newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen approved 139 investment projects in H1.
newsitem.headline: Yemen approved 139 investment projects in H1.

text.p: Yemen's General Investment Authority (GIA) on Saturday said it approved 139 new investment projects in the year to June.
A statement by GIA said the new projects would have about 15 billion rials ($120 million) in fixed assets and more than 56 billion rials in investment costs.
Of the 139 new projects, 54 licences were issued for industrial firms, 53 for general services ventures, 20 for tourism projects and 12 for agriculture and fisheries.
GIA said the new projects would create 7,750 new jobs.
It was not clear from the report what percentage of the investments came from outside Yemen.
Yemen, one of the Arab world's poorest states, is implementing stringent economic reforms to control rising unemployement, curb a culminating budget deficit and attract foreign investments.
